IEHG-PSS-M1.description: Inelastic Hinge Property Assignment - Pushover Shell/PSS (IEHG-PSS-M1). Links a model object (keyed by id) to a previously defined inelastic hinge property by its name; the named property must already exist in the model.

INEL_PROP_NAME.description: Name of the inelastic hinge property to assign. Must reference an existing Inelastic Hinge Property in the model, otherwise the request is rejected with a wrong-data error.
